ભાવ વિશ્લેષણ

ભાવ 1: આત્મા, લગ્ન, વ્યક્તિત્વ

સ્વામી: શનિ (માં Sagittarius)

The ascendant governs the self, body, temperament, and overall vitality, the lens through which the whole chart expresses. Its lord currently occupies house 11, channelling these themes there.

ભાવ 2: ધન, કુટુંબ, વાણી

સ્વામી: ગુરુ (માં Gemini)

Governs accumulated wealth, family, speech, food, and early upbringing, the resources and values one gathers. Its lord currently occupies house 5, channelling these themes there.
